description:
§2.1 Suite entity: named frozen collection of TaskVersion members.

frozen_at set makes the instance reject all further mutation (enforced via
__setattr__ guard + model validator). This is the contract that prevents
post-freeze drift in parallel epic work.

frozen_at.description: timestamp at which the suite was frozen; when set the instance is immutable
frozen_at.title: Frozen At

members.description: TaskVersion references (task_ref@version strings) that constitute the suite
members.title: Members

version.description: suite version; increments on content change
version.title: Version

title: Suite
